# v1.15.0

## Per-user attribution: who created it, who marked it done, who edited it last

Every task and every To-Do (Nabava) Stavka now shows a small muted **badge
line** answering the three "who" questions:

- **➕ Created by** — set when the task/Stavka is created (web or mobile).
- **✓ Done by** (tasks) / **🛒 Bought by** (Stavke) — the user who ticked it
  as done/bought. Cleared automatically on untick. For checklist tasks the
  actor who ticked the **last remaining item** gets the badge — that moment is
  when the task actually completes. Works for the checkbox, the PATCH
  `completed` flag, and checklist ticks alike.
- **✏️ Edited by** — the last user who changed it: rename, description,
  assignee, column move, checklist add/tick/delete, Stavka rename. Hidden when
  it would just repeat the creator/done name on the same line.

The badges appear in all three views: **mobile board** (task cards + the
per-board To-Do panel), **mobile Nabava** (aggregated rows), and the **web
app** (task cards, board To-Do panel, global Nabava). Existing/legacy rows
have no attribution stored and simply show no badge — nothing else changes.

### API (additive only — frozen contract respected)
- `tasks` gained `completed_by_id`, `edited_by_id`, `edited_at`; `todo_entries`
  gained `created_by_id`, `done_by_id`, `edited_by_id`, `edited_at`
  (idempotent `ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS` migrations on startup;
  all nullable).
- `serialize_task` now also returns `created_by`, `completed_by`, `edited_by`,
  `edited_at`; `serialize_todo_entries` and the Nabava rows return
  `created_by`, `done_by`, `edited_by`, `edited_at` — all display names,
  all optional fields (older clients ignore them).
- `DELETE /api/users/{id}`: creation attribution is re-linked to the acting
  admin (same as `tasks.created_by_id` since v1.14.1); completed/done/edited
  attribution is cleared (the user row would otherwise break the FK).

## Verified
- Backend: **16/16 pytest** (6 new attribution tests: created/completed/edited
  on tasks and entries, checklist last-actor attribution, Nabava manual items,
  delete-user FK cleanup + the full pre-existing suite).
- Mobile: `flutter analyze` clean and **36/36 tests** (7 new) in the pinned
  CI image `ghcr.io/cirruslabs/flutter:3.24.3`.
- Web: `node --check frontend/app.js`.
